title: LLM4Review: A Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Peer Review of AI-Written Research

contributions.purpose: 模拟端到端科学出版流程
contributions.mechanism: Author/Reviewer/Reviser/Meta-Reviewer 四角色闭环 + 轮次协议
contributions.evaluation: 默认 R=3+Planner 达 Q(2)=0.671、Accept@R2 56%;R=5+CR+Plan Q=0.703、67%
contributions.source_quote: a closed-loop, multi-agent framework that assigns large language models (LLMs) to the canonical roles of Author, Reviewer, Reviser, and Meta-Reviewer

contributions.purpose: 提供可审计的评分与决策机制且保证终止
contributions.mechanism: 可靠性加权聚合(Eq.2-3)+ 阈值决策规则(Eq.4)+ 计算/延迟预算
contributions.evaluation: 阈值 τacc=0.70、τmin=0.60、Kmin=4、Tmax=2;超预算强制终止
contributions.source_quote: a general scoring and decision mechanism with reliability gating and strict budgets

contributions.purpose: 量化自我改进、偏差与鲁棒性
contributions.evaluation: 偏差小但显著(order 0.012、verbosity 0.010、self-model 0.008 on Q);High 攻击 ΔAccept 无防御 14.2 p.p.→sanitization+provenance 3.1 p.p.
contributions.source_quote: a measurement suite for score gains, reviewer agreement, bias, cost/latency, and robustness

contributions.mechanism: 公开 prompts、logs、topic bank(24 seed prompts)、分析代码
contributions.evaluation: 无需外部数据集,附录含 provenance 哈希
contributions.source_quote: openly documented prompts, logs, and topic bank for reproducibility

self_declared_provenance.quote: We differ from prior work by constructing a closed-loop, end-to-end simulation of the publication cycle
we combine self-revision (Self-Refine/Reflexion) with LLM-as-judge evaluation and multi-agent debate/consensus under peer-review rubrics

notes: 数据红旗(多):两处 checklist(AI Involvement + Paper Checklist)全部为 [TODO]/未填——正是 desk-reject 直接原因(未披露 AI 参与)。结果表 Table1-4 数字异常干净、无置信区间,却声称报告 95% CI;论文自述 R0 的 tables/plots 均为 placeholder,全文更像模板+疑似编造的结果表而非真实实验。References 未给出(“References follow ... camera-ready”)。自称首个闭环多智能体同行评审模拟。trade-off:质量-成本 Pareto——R=5 质量最高(Q=0.703)但 89.6k tokens/18.3min;prompt-injection 防御只减不消(残留 drift)。四元组以论文 Contributions in brief 四项自声明列表为准。
